scope: Primary-source architecture and local-weights screening; no new model runtime benchmark

models.name: Laya
models.output: Logits gathered at option marker positions, not document token BIO labels
models.question_batching: Separate encoder sequence per question in a batch; state tokenization can be shared
models.structured_output: Choice, boolean Noul, bounded ordinal Score; no dynamic list of arbitrary PII byte spans

models.name: Jev
models.output: One typed Choice/Score/Noul answer per declared question
models.extraction_cookbook: Selection among pre-parsed candidate values, not discovery of all unknown PII spans
models.context_documented_tokens: 64k per request; 32k for state plus longest question

models.name: CLM
models.architecture: Frozen Qwen3-8B, last-token pooling, state/action projection heads, contrastive candidate scoring
models.question_batching: Context plus each question embedded separately; candidate embeddings can be cached
models.output: Candidate probabilities, not per-token BIO or byte spans

decision.existing_student: Already computes all token BIO labels in a window in one forward pass; no autoregressive generation
decision.context_limit: A single forward pass applies to a bounded model input, not all of 1 MiB or 50 MiB
decision.local_candidate: Laya multilingual/mmBERT encoder with a separately trained token/span head
decision.required_acceptance: Hash-verified pinned weights, no losses or benign regressions on frozen multilingual PII suite, successful actual Vault/Session workflow and measured 1 MiB within10seconds
